description: Ex-Turkish Air Force CF-104, Canadair construction number 683A-1043, previously Royal Canadian Air Force 104743 and Turkish 8-743 with 8 AJU. Spottingmode records it as preserved at Al Mafraq and gives the serial as 62-743; the International F-104 Society places it at Al al-Bayt University, Mafraq. The coordinate used here is spottingmode's and lies about 5 km north-east of the Al al-Bayt main campus, so the host site is not fully resolved.
